notes.subject: מגיד/משמיע/שמע
notes.rationale: Repetition of שׁמע root and נגד root — threefold 'ulac win' refrain builds the rhetorical triple, kept by repeating 'xas, ulac win'.

notes.subject: ומלפנים
notes.rationale: Literally 'and from before (faces)' — rendered 'uqbel kan' (beforehand); some read 'from the east' (panim as direction).

notes.subject: צדיק
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'ṣadiq' = righteous/just; 'Iqedc' from qdc root per discipline, contextually 'He is in the right'.

notes.subject: awalen-nnwen
notes.rationale: Direct address to the idols/followers — 'your words', second-person plural ending in אמריכם.

notes.subject: anwa i d-yennan
notes.rationale: Rhetorical challenge question: who announced it from the beginning — only Yahwe can, no one else heard or declared.

translation: Anwa i d-yennan seg tazwara, iwakken ad neẓ? Uqbel kan, iwakken ad nini: Iqedc? Xas, ulac win i d-yennan, xas, ulac win immeslayen, xas, ulac win isellen ⟨awalen-nnwen⟩.
